items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 19:1
items.html: (To the question) In the Mochin of the posterior she has no aspect of her own MAN, namely feminine MAN, from the aspect of Malchut. And her Mochin are drawn from the male MAN of the Dikna, namely from the aspect of the MAN of the Ima of the AB of the Mazal; and these NHY of Ima clothe in her together with the Mochin. But in the Mochin of the front she has an aspect of her own feminine MAN, namely from the aspect of Malchut that is drawn to her from the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in her NHY of the Mazal, and is clothed in the Mochin of ZA; and there, in the head of ZA, a special coupling is made upon her, for the sake of the Mochin of the Nukva. And these Mochin clothe in the NHY of ZA, which become Mochin for the Nukva. Thus the Mochin of the posterior emerge from the Aba and Ima of AB, who clothe the GAR of AA and couple upon the MAN of the Mazal, from which the Mochin of ZA come. But the Mochin of the front of the Nukva emerge from the coupling made in the head of ZA, and they have from the aspect of the Mochin of the Mazal only a mere illumination, by the crown of Gevura of ZA.
